reader.requirement: At 1985 an ADVANCING mnemonic-name-1 must be a mnemonic-name defined in SPECIAL-NAMES (its own or a containing program's) for an implementor feature (C01, CSP) and positions the page per that feature; a switch's or device's mnemonic, an undefined name, and LINE/LINES after the mnemonic are refused.

edition-consulted.switches: BEFORE and AFTER together refused below 2023 (not the mnemonic operand)

reader.edition-search: grep of SequentialIoBinder.cs, MnemonicRegistry.cs and ImplementorNames.cs for DialectLevel/CobolVersion/ConstructRegistry/edition: the feature-name table and the mnemonic lookup are edition-invariant
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers the refusal of a device-name mnemonic (SYSOUT); the feature-name acceptance and its positioning, a switch mnemonic, an undefined name and a container's mnemonic are not exercised

probes.printed: WRITTEN; w6a.prt bytes: \f AAAAA \r BBBBB \r \n CCCCC \n
probes.expected: C01 (AFTER) skips to a new page before the line; CSP (BEFORE) presents the line with no advance (implementor rule, §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR17 d)

probes.printed: COBOL2243 SW1 is a switch-name's mnemonic; COBOL2243 OUT-DEV is a device-name's; COBOL1639 NOT-DEFINED is not defined; COBOL2269 LINES after a mnemonic; COBOL0862 mnemonic on a LINAGE file
probes.expected: a mnemonic not associated with a feature, or not defined in SPECIAL-NAMES, is refused
a contained program's WRITE uses the container's SPECIAL-NAMES mnemonic

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR6  (4.7.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR6

reader.notes: MnemonicOperand resolves the operand word through the SPECIAL-NAMES registry (own, then container's); FeatureAdvancing refuses a non-feature row (COBOL2243) and maps C01 to the page advance and CSP to a zero-line advance from the one ImplementorNames table. An undefined name falls to the data resolver (COBOL1639).

refuter.evidence: r7a.cob (r7a-001): C01 IS TOP-PAGE with BEFORE ADVANCING (line then form feed) and CSP IS NO-SPACE with AFTER ADVANCING: file bytes AAAAA \f BBBBB \n CCCCC \n, positioning per the implementor's feature rows (GR16d). r7b.cob: a contained program declaring its own CONFIGURATION SECTION / SPECIAL-NAMES C01 IS TOP-PAGE is refused COBOL1643, as §1985:VI.4.2 requires (cite.py OK: "The Configuration Section must not be stated in a program which is contained directly or indirectly within another program"), so at 85 a mnemonic can only come from the outermost program's SPECIAL-NAMES. Reader's w6b covers switch/device mnemonics, undefined name, LINES after a mnemonic, LINAGE file. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.7.3 SR6. Cosmetic: COBOL1643's message cites only §2023.
